name: Axiomtek Co., Ltd.
summary: Axiomtek Co., Ltd. engages in manufacturing, sales, and post-sales service of industrial computer and embedded board products worldwide. It offers industrial and embedded motherboard, system on module, PICMG single board computer, add-on-card and peripheral, and smart display module; and systems and platforms, such as embedded system, industrial pc, machine vision, edge AI GPU computing, transportation system, network communication platform, digital signage players, and medical-grade system. The company also provides industrial panel PCs, including fanless touch panel PC, touch panel PC and monitor, medical computing, transportation computing, interactive touchscreen kiosk; and AIoT solution…
